footer.about_body: Freight forwarding between Belgium and the DRC. Air, sea, ground — transparent tracking every step of the way.
footer.legal: © {{year}} Luna Tracking Logistics. All rights reserved.

home.meta_title: Luna Tracking Logistics — Belgium-DRC freight, transparent tracking
home.meta_description: Air, sea and ground freight forwarding between Belgium and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fast quotes, real-time tracking, full handling of your goods.
home.hero_subtitle: Your goods are our priority. Air, sea and ground shipping between Belgium and the DRC, with transparent tracking at every step.
home.pillars_subtitle: One partner for the whole logistics chain.
home.pillar_air_body: Fast delivery for urgent shipments and high-value goods.
home.pillar_sea_body: Cost-efficient solution for larger volumes and container shipments.
home.pillar_ground_body: Door-to-door pickup, depot handling and final-mile distribution.
home.pillar_tracking_body: Full visibility on your parcels via your personal tracking password.
home.how_step1_body: Fill in the form with your origin, destination and estimated volume — we come back to you quickly.
home.how_step2_body: Pickup, safe packing, customs clearance — we take care of it all.
home.how_step3_body: Follow your shipment online with your personal password until final delivery.

tracking.meta_title: Track a shipment — Luna Tracking Logistics
tracking.meta_description: Track your Luna Tracking Logistics shipment with your tracking password. Real-time visibility on your parcels between Belgium and the DRC.
tracking.page_intro: Enter the tracking password you received with your shipping slip.
tracking.unavailable_body: Our online tracking service is not live yet. Email us at info@lunatrackinglogistics.be with your tracking password and we will reply promptly.
tracking.empty_result: No shipment found for that password. Check it or contact us.

pricing.meta_description: Get a tailored quote for your shipment between Belgium and the DRC. Air, sea and ground freight. Fast reply, no commitment.
pricing.page_intro: Describe your shipment in a few lines — we come back with a clear, no-surprise rate.
pricing.success_body: Our team will get back to you shortly with a detailed quote. A confirmation was sent to the email you provided.

contact.meta_description: Contact Luna Tracking Logistics: info@lunatrackinglogistics.be, Rue de l'Automne 59, 1050 Ixelles. Instagram @Luna_TrackingLogistics.
contact.page_intro: A question about a shipment, a quote in progress, a tracking issue? We reply fast.
contact.hours_body: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Email reply within one business day.

auth.login_intro: Access your client area to find your shipments and invoices.
auth.signup_intro: One account to track shipments, keep history and retrieve invoices.
auth.forgot_intro: Enter your email — we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.signup_check_inbox_body: We've sent a verification link to:
auth.signup_check_inbox_hint: Click the link to confirm your email. Check your spam folder if you don't see it within 2-3 minutes.

account.shipments_empty_body: Your shipments will appear here as soon as we register your first shipment in our system.
account.orders_placeholder: The full history of your orders will be available here soon.
account.invoices_placeholder: Your invoices will be downloadable from this page as soon as the billing module goes live.

onboarding.title: Welcome!
onboarding.subtitle: To personalise your space, tell us how you'll use our services.
onboarding.individual_body: For sending parcels or goods on a personal basis. Simple space: new shipment, tracking, history, addresses.
onboarding.business_body: To manage professional shipments, clients, quotes, invoices and reports. Full space, multi-user capable.
onboarding.change_later: You can change this choice later from your profile.

business_dashboard.welcome_body: Your account is set up as a business. Full modules are rolling out progressively.
business_dashboard.coming_kpi: Dashboard with KPIs (shipments, quotes, invoices, margin)
business_dashboard.coming_quotes: Quotes with one-click conversion into a shipment
business_dashboard.coming_reports: Monthly reports + export to your accountant

business_create.meta_title: Create your business — Luna Tracking Logistics
business_create.title: Create your business
business_create.intro: A couple more details and your business space is ready. VAT, address, and full profile can be filled right after.
business_create.later_hint: You can edit any of this at any time from Settings.

business_team.title: Team
business_team.intro: Invite teammates and assign a role. Each role carries its own permissions; access is enforced server-side.
business_team.invite_hint: The invitee gets access as soon as they create an account with this email.
business_team.remove_confirm: Remove this member from the business?

business_settings.title: Business settings
business_settings.intro: These details appear on the quotes, invoices and documents you send to your clients.
business_settings.readonly_note: Only the business owner can edit these fields. You can view them.
business_settings.section_invoicing_hint: These fields are required for professional invoicing and future Peppol compatibility.

business_placeholder.coming_soon: This module arrives in a later phase of the chantier.
business_placeholder.shipments_body: Create, duplicate and track professional shipments with reusable templates and unified statuses.
business_placeholder.quotes_body: Multi-line quotes, one-click send to client, one-click convert to shipment.
business_placeholder.clients_body: Mini CRM: client cards with full history (quotes, shipments, invoices, payments).
business_placeholder.invoicing_body: Shipment-linked invoicing, PDF, client send, Peppol-ready structure.
business_placeholder.expenses_body: Track expenses per shipment + automatic margin calculation.
business_placeholder.reports_body: Monthly reports (revenue, margin, VAT, expenses by category) + export to your accountant.
business_placeholder.documents_body: Document library (BL, supplier invoices, receipts) per client / shipment.

business_clients.title: Clients
business_clients.intro: Your business and individual customers. Each card centralises contact, addresses, notes and history.
business_clients.empty: No clients yet. Click "New client" to get started.

business_client_form.readonly_note: You don't have permission to edit clients. Read-only view.
business_client_form.section_invoicing_hint: VAT number + company number will be used on Peppol-ready quotes and invoices.
business_client_form.field_display_name_hint: The name you see in lists. Auto-generated — editable.
business_client_form.field_notes_placeholder: Any useful internal info: preferred contact, history, terms...

business_client_detail.addresses_empty: No address on file. Add one to reuse it on quotes and shipments.
business_client_detail.history_placeholder: Will populate as later phases ship (quotes, shipments, invoices).
business_client_detail.history_note: Every quote, shipment and invoice created for this client will appear here automatically.
business_client_detail.no_shipments: No shipments for this client yet.

business_shipments.title: Shipments
business_shipments.intro: Every shipment centralises client, route, packages, billable costs and tracking. Create from a template to skip re-entry.
business_shipments.empty: No shipments. Click "New shipment" to get started.

business_shipment_form.readonly_note: You don't have write access to shipments.
business_shipment_form.section_totals_hint: High-level summary. Per-package details entered from the detail page.
business_shipment_form.notes_placeholder: Special instructions, driver contact, time windows...

business_shipment_detail.package_totals_volume_partial: partial volume — some packages have no dimensions
business_shipment_detail.package_totals_adopt_hint: Copies these values into the shipment header (weight, volume).
business_shipment_detail.packages_empty: No packages yet. Add package details to prepare the manifest and customs documents.
business_shipment_detail.charges_empty: No billable costs yet. Add transport, handling, customs... to prepare the client invoice.
business_shipment_detail.documents_hint: Invoice, packing list, BL/CMR/AWB, customs paperwork, photos — 25 MB max per file.
business_shipment_detail.docs_drop_zone: Drag & drop files here, or click "Upload files".
business_shipment_detail.add_note_placeholder: e.g. Customer asked to advance pickup to Sep 12…
business_shipment_detail.tracking_off_body: Turn on the link to share tracking with your consignee — no account, no password.
business_shipment_detail.tracking_on_body: This link lets your consignee see status and key milestones. Full addresses, costs, and internal notes stay hidden.
business_shipment_detail.tracking_rotate: Generate a new link (invalidates the old one)
business_shipment_detail.tracking_rotate_confirm: Generate a new link? The old one will stop working.

rate_calc.meta_title: Freight rate calculator — Luna Tracking Logistics
rate_calc.meta_description: Estimate a Belgium ↔ DR Congo shipment in 30 seconds — air, sea, road. Customer price incl. tax by weight and volume.
rate_calc.heading: Estimate your shipping rate
rate_calc.intro: Belgium ↔ DR Congo, air / sea / road. Indicative price, taxes included.
rate_calc.same_country_warning: Pick different origin and destination countries.
rate_calc.no_results: No rates available for this route yet.
rate_calc.footer_note: Indicative rates. A firm quote is issued after final dimensions and goods description are confirmed.
rate_calc.error_generic: Rate lookup failed. Please try again in a moment.

public_tracking.heading: Your shipment
public_tracking.intro: Follow your shipment's progress in real time.
public_tracking.not_found_body: This tracking link is no longer valid. Ask your shipper for a new one.

admin.dashboard_body: Admin console. Detailed content (statistics, shipments, users) will be added chantier by chantier.
admin.cities_intro: Manage the destination cities offered in the quote form. A city marked "coming soon" stays visible but is not selectable.
admin.products_intro: Manage the Shop & Ship catalog. Add one product manually, import a batch via CSV, or scan a barcode to look up / add quickly.
admin.products_delete_confirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.
admin.product_field_slugs_hint: One distinct slug per language — site rule: no EN URL should be forced into FR. Auto-generate from the matching-language name.
admin.product_seo_section: SEO — how the product shows up in Google
admin.hs_detect_intro: Analyses the product name and description to suggest an HS code. Always review the suggestion before applying.
admin.hs_no_match: No match found in our library — enter the code manually.
admin.product_field_barcode_hint: Scan or type. Focus returns here after each save so you can scan in a run.
admin.products_import_intro: Upload a CSV with columns: slug_fr, slug_en, name_fr, name_en, description_fr, description_en, price, category_slug, barcode, hs_code, weight_kg, image_url. A legacy single `slug` column is accepted (used for both languages).
admin.categories_intro: Products must belong to a category. Add, rename or delete here (a category used by at least one product cannot be deleted).
admin.forwarding_admin_intro: Leads received via the forwarding request form.

shop.meta_title: Shop & Ship — We buy in Belgium and deliver to the DRC
shop.meta_description: Order Belgian products (groceries, hygiene, canned goods): Luna buys them in Belgium and delivers to you in the DRC. Pay upfront, tracked delivery.
shop.page_intro: Pick Belgian products — we buy them in Belgium and ship them to you in the DRC with full Luna tracking.
shop.how_step1: You pick your products and pay upfront on this page.
shop.how_step2: Our team physically buys the products in Belgium.
shop.how_step3: We consolidate your parcel and ship it to the DRC — you track it online.
shop.checkout_intro: Review your cart and fill in the DRC delivery details.
shop.checkout_success_body: Thank you! Your order has been created. Someone from our team will reach out to finalise payment.
shop.checkout_signin_required: You must be signed in to complete an order.
shop.detail_not_found_body: This product does not exist or has been removed from the catalog.

forwarding.meta_title: International forwarding to the DRC — Luna Tracking Logistics
forwarding.meta_description: Already bought abroad (US, China, Europe)? Luna arranges pickup and consolidated shipment to the DRC. Quote on request.
forwarding.intro: Your goods are already abroad. Luna consolidates and forwards them to the DRC through our network of local partners.
forwarding.how_step1_body: Describe your goods, their country of origin, and their estimated value in the form below.
forwarding.how_step2_body: Our associate on the ground handles pickup and transport to our consolidation point.
forwarding.how_step3_body: We batch your shipment with others and forward it to the DRC — Luna tracking takes over from there.
forwarding.example_us_body: Amazon purchase delivered to our partner in Newark, consolidated every 2 weeks, shipped by air.
forwarding.example_cn_body: Factory sourcing in Guangzhou, container grouping in Shenzhen, sea to Matadi, final-mile delivery.
forwarding.form_intro: A few lines is enough — we come back with a transport plan and an indicative rate.
forwarding.form_description: Description of the goods (type, quantity, dimensions/weight if known)
forwarding.form_success_body: Thanks! We'll get back to you shortly with a transport plan and an indicative rate.

account_orders.title: My order history
account_orders.empty_body: Your Shop & Ship orders will appear here.

admin_blog.intro: Create, edit and publish blog articles.
admin_blog.delete_confirm: Delete this article? This cannot be undone.

rebuild.title: Rebuild the site
rebuild.intro: Manually redeploy the site (fresh build from the latest code). Useful after a server-side change or to retry a failed deploy. Text / image edits made via the editor are visible immediately — no rebuild needed for those.
rebuild.refresh_hint: Re-reads the state of the latest deploy on GitHub without triggering a new one.
rebuild.buttons_explainer: "Rebuild now" kicks off a new deployment (build + push to Cloudflare, ~2 minutes). "Refresh status" only re-reads the state of the most recent deploy shown below — handy to watch a run flip from "In progress" to "Success" without waiting 60 s.

rich_text_editor.source_placeholder: Raw HTML — disallowed tags are stripped on exit.

block.now_hidden: Block hidden from the public site

admin_content.title: Page content
admin_content.intro: Edit titles, body text, SEO meta and images for every public page. Leaving a field empty restores the site default. Changes are visible immediately (no redeploy needed).
admin_content.remove_confirm: Remove this image and fall back to the default?
admin_content.translated: Translation loaded into the other field
admin_content.reset_tooltip: Clear the custom value and fall back to the site default
admin_content.reset_confirm: Clear your custom value and fall back to the site default?
admin_content.markdown_hint: Tip: you can use Markdown for formatting — **bold**, *italic*, - bullet list, 1. numbered list, [link text](https://…).
admin_content.hero_remove_confirm: Remove the background image and fall back to the default?
admin_content.hero_drag_hint: Click and drag on the preview to move the point that stays centered.
admin_content.hero_zoom_hint: 100% = image just covers the band. Increase to crop tighter.
admin_content.hero_overlay_hint: Darkens the image so white text stays legible.

admin_auth.title: Social logins
admin_auth.intro: Enable Google and Facebook sign-in buttons on the login and signup pages. Client credentials (Client ID + Client Secret) are configured in the Supabase dashboard — this panel only controls whether the button is visible.
admin_auth.setup_step1: Create an OAuth application with the provider (Google Cloud Console for Google, Meta for Developers for Facebook) and copy its Client ID + Client Secret.
admin_auth.setup_step2: Open the Supabase dashboard (button below), section Authentication → Providers, enable the provider and paste the credentials.
admin_auth.setup_step3: Come back here and flip the switch — the button appears on the login and signup pages.

admin_pages.title: Pages
admin_pages.intro: Create and publish custom pages (about, legal, landing pages, etc.). Each page has a FR URL and an EN URL, an H1, a meta title and description, and a share image — everything Bing and Google expect.
admin_pages.empty: No pages yet. Click "New page" to get started.
admin_pages.field_slugs_hint: Each language has its own URL. Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only. A few paths are reserved (tracking, pricing, blog, admin, ...) — pick another word.
admin_pages.slug_reserved: This slug is reserved by an existing page. Pick another word.
admin_pages.title_is_h1: This text becomes the H1 on the public page — the first content signal Bing and Google read.
admin_pages.image_alt_prompt: Briefly describe this image (for screen readers and SEO):
admin_pages.slug_required_upload: Enter a URL before adding an image.
admin_pages.section_seo: SEO — title and description in search results
